helpers.title: Technique notes
helpers.salineText: Nasal saline irrigation: {volume} each side, {frequency, plural, one {# time a day} other {# times a day}}. Lean forward and let the wash drain.
helpers.sprayText: Tilt the head slightly forward. Hold the bottle in the opposite hand and aim toward the outer wall of the nose, away from the septum. Breathe in gently while spraying.
helpers.dropsText: Lie with the treated ear upward. Instil the drops, then press the tragus gently so the drops pass inward. Stay in that position for a short while.
